standardsRefs: Manuel Academy local Ready for Life composition
objective: I can practice safety and supervision. I will do one step at a time and check one result.
scenario: With a trusted adult, the learner goes through their planned contribution step by step and sorts each step into one of three categories — needs adult supervision the whole time, needs adult permission but not presence, or fully independent — with the adult confirming or correcting each judgment.
safetyNotes: The adult reviews every step of the plan before the contribution is carried out.
Any step involving heat, sharp tools, appliances, chemicals, height, or unfamiliar equipment defaults to 'needs supervision' unless the adult explicitly says otherwise.

simulationAlternative.description: If the adult who will supervise the eventual task can't review the plan together in one sitting, the learner instead writes out their proposed three-category sort for every step with reasoning, and the adult reviews and confirms it in writing or verbally afterward, rather than sorting live together.

tasks.directions: Open swk-rfl-g5-u06-l03-model-card. Watch one complete example.

prompts.text: Name the first move in the model and explain why it comes first.

tasks.directions: Open swk-rfl-g5-u06-l03-guided-card. Do the coached move.

prompts.text: Name the move you completed and the success check it meets.

tasks.directions: Open swk-rfl-g5-u06-l03-independent-card. Choose one complete route. Follow its steps.

prompts.text: Which complete route did you use?
Record the completed step numbers and one non-sensitive result statement.

tasks.directions: Open swk-rfl-g5-u06-l03-evidence-record. Save one result and one reflection.

prompts.text: Was there a step you assumed you could do fully independently that your adult said needed supervision (or the reverse)? What made that step’s category less obvious?

remediation: Compare the missed move with the worked move on swk-rfl-g5-u06-l03-model-card; name one observable difference and review only the matching instruction step. Complete the affected move on swk-rfl-g5-u06-l03-guided-card with one coach prompt and receive feedback tied to the success check. Name the observable move that now meets the check and the one move, if any, that still needs correction. Do not use shame, trait, effort, or character judgments. Complete the same move on the fresh parallel condition in swk-rfl-g5-u06-l03-retry-pair without the coach prompt. Exit: The supported and parallel moves both meet the named success check: Supervision-category accuracy: All but one step sorted correctly, confirmed by the adult. | Adjusting to adult correction: Learner accepts and updates the plan when corrected. Resume at the next unfinished step on swk-rfl-g5-u06-l03-independent-card. A physical task resumes only with required permission and supervision; otherwise finish the equal-credit fictional route.
extension: Identify one step currently marked 'needs supervision' and describe what skill-building would need to happen before that step could move to 'fully independent' in the future.

productionDepth.practicalGoal: I can practice safety and supervision. I will do one step at a time and check one result.

duration.sessionPattern: 5 minutes model, 5–7 minutes guided try, 10–15 minutes learner task, 5 minutes evidence and retry check
duration.adultTime: 10–20 minutes for permission, required supervision or review, and physical-event attestation

materials.noPurchaseRule: No purchase is required. Use the complete fictional route when a local material, setting, source, or adult is unavailable.

resources.title: safety and supervision worked model
resources.purpose: Shows the starting condition, visible moves, reasoning, and success check before the learner begins.
content: Starting condition: With a trusted adult, the learner goes through their planned contribution step by step and sorts each step into one of three categories — needs adult supervision the whole time, needs adult permission but not presence, or fully independent — with the adult confirming or correcting each judgment.
Model move 1: Read the condition and name the exact safety and supervision decision or action.
Model move 2: Before reviewing with your adult, guess which one step of your plan you think will need the most supervision, and why.
Model move 3: With your adult, go through your plan step by step and sort each into: needs supervision, needs permission only, or fully independent.
Model check: Supervision-category accuracy: All but one step sorted correctly, confirmed by the adult. | Adjusting to adult correction: Learner accepts and updates the plan when corrected.

resources.title: safety and supervision action steps
resources.purpose: Provides the ordered directions used by the model, guided attempt, independent task, and retry.
content: 1. Read the goal for safety and supervision.
2. Watch the worked move on swk-rfl-g5-u06-l03-model-card.
3. Do one coached move on swk-rfl-g5-u06-l03-guided-card.
4. Complete the chosen route on swk-rfl-g5-u06-l03-independent-card.
5. Save the small record on swk-rfl-g5-u06-l03-evidence-record; use swk-rfl-g5-u06-l03-retry-pair if a step is missed.

resources.title: safety and supervision coached first attempt
resources.purpose: Carries the complete first attempt and a fresh correction turn.
content: Fictional practice condition: With a trusted adult, the learner goes through their planned contribution step by step and sorts each step into one of three categories — needs adult supervision the whole time, needs adult permission but not presence, or fully independent — with the adult confirming or correcting each judgment.
Coach direction: Before reviewing with your adult, guess which one step of your plan you think will need the most supervision, and why.
Learner prompt: Name the step and your reasoning.
Feedback check: name the move completed, point to the matching success check, and identify one missing or uncertain step without judging the learner.
Fresh correction turn: use the same fictional condition with one constraint changed; restate the changed constraint, redo only the affected step, and check the new result.

resources.title: safety and supervision complete application
resources.purpose: Contains the lesson-specific application directions and prompts; it is the delivered card referenced by the learner flow.
content: Application direction: With your adult, go through your plan step by step and sort each into: needs supervision, needs permission only, or fully independent.
Response 1 (t2-p1): Every step in my plan is sorted into exactly one of the three categories.
Response 2 (t2-p2): My adult confirmed or corrected each sort.
Response 3 (t2-p3): For every 'needs supervision' step, I named the specific reason (heat, sharp tool, height, chemical, unfamiliar equipment, etc.).

Equal-access rule: If the adult who will supervise the eventual task can't review the plan together in one sitting, the learner instead writes out their proposed three-category sort for every step with reasoning, and the adult reviews and confirms it in writing or verbally afterward, rather than sorting live together.

resources.title: safety and supervision minimal evidence record
resources.purpose: Defines exactly what the learner saves and what must not be collected.
content: Record only: selected route, completed step numbers, one non-sensitive result statement, and one revision if a step changed.
Reflection: Was there a step you assumed you could do fully independently that your adult said needed supervision (or the reverse)? What made that step’s category less obvious?
Success checks: Supervision-category accuracy: All but one step sorted correctly, confirmed by the adult. | Adjusting to adult correction: Learner accepts and updates the plan when corrected.
Do not collect: names, signatures, addresses, or exact locations; account, identification, medical, product, or medicine details; photos, audio, video, passwords, or private household schedules.

resources.title: safety and supervision supported and parallel retry cards
resources.purpose: Delivers a real correction loop rather than a direction to try again without support.
content: Contrast reteach: compare the model check on swk-rfl-g5-u06-l03-model-card with the missed or unsupported step; name the one observable difference.
Supported card: return to swk-rfl-g5-u06-l03-guided-card, complete the affected move with one coach prompt, and receive criterion-specific feedback.
Parallel card: use a fresh fictional safety and supervision condition with one changed constraint; complete the same move without the coach prompt.

Exit check: the corrected move meets this lesson's checks — Supervision-category accuracy: All but one step sorted correctly, confirmed by the adult. | Adjusting to adult correction: Learner accepts and updates the plan when corrected..
Return: resume at the next unfinished step on swk-rfl-g5-u06-l03-independent-card; a physical route resumes only when the authorized adult says it is safe.

resources.title: safety and supervision delivered plan
resources.purpose: Resolves the lesson's named plan so the learner is never directed to a phantom material.

guidedFirstAttempt.setup: With a trusted adult, the learner goes through their planned contribution step by step and sorts each step into one of three categories — needs adult supervision the whole time, needs adult permission but not presence, or fully independent — with the adult confirming or correcting each judgment.
guidedFirstAttempt.prompt: Name the step and your reasoning.
coachMoves: Ask the learner to name the condition.
Point to one model step only.
Give feedback against one observable success check.
guidedFirstAttempt.successCondition: Supervision-category accuracy: All but one step sorted correctly, confirmed by the adult.

realRoute.title: safety and supervision — permitted real-life route
realRoute.permissionRule: Do not begin the physical action until a household-authorized guardian gives permission and is available for the supervision or review named in this lesson.
steps: Confirm the setting, materials, and stop condition before acting.
With your adult, go through your plan step by step and sort each into: needs supervision, needs permission only, or fully independent.
Complete the response prompts on the delivered independent card without recording private identifying details.
Check the result against the delivered evidence record and correct any missed step.
realRoute.completionCondition: The learner submits the minimal process record; only the household-authorized guardian attests that the named physical action occurred.

simulationRoute.title: safety and supervision — complete fictional route
simulationRoute.directions: If the adult who will supervise the eventual task can't review the plan together in one sitting, the learner instead writes out their proposed three-category sort for every step with reasoning, and the adult reviews and confirms it in writing or verbally afterward, rather than sorting live together.
simulationRoute.completionCondition: Complete the same decision, procedure, evidence, and revision checks as the real-life route. No adult attests that a physical event occurred.

independentTask.privacyAlternative: The learner may use invented names, dates, amounts, organizations, spaces, and circumstances whenever real details are unnecessary or private.

retry.trigger: Start the correction loop when a required step is missing, the reason does not match the condition, a safety or privacy boundary is crossed, or the evidence does not show the stated result.
retry.targetedReteach: Compare the missed move with the worked move on swk-rfl-g5-u06-l03-model-card; name one observable difference and review only the matching instruction step.
retry.supportedReattempt: Complete the affected move on swk-rfl-g5-u06-l03-guided-card with one coach prompt and receive feedback tied to the success check.
retry.feedback: Name the observable move that now meets the check and the one move, if any, that still needs correction. Do not use shame, trait, effort, or character judgments.
retry.parallelReattempt: Complete the same move on the fresh parallel condition in swk-rfl-g5-u06-l03-retry-pair without the coach prompt.
retry.exitCriterion: The supported and parallel moves both meet the named success check: Supervision-category accuracy: All but one step sorted correctly, confirmed by the adult. | Adjusting to adult correction: Learner accepts and updates the plan when corrected.
retry.returnPath: Resume at the next unfinished step on swk-rfl-g5-u06-l03-independent-card. A physical task resumes only with required permission and supervision; otherwise finish the equal-credit fictional route.

guardianInvolvement.role: Give permission; provide only the supervision, handling, review, or observation named in the lesson; attest only that the physical event occurred.
guardianInvolvement.signOffBoundary: A guardian attestation certifies only that the named physical event occurred. It never scores the learner reflection or proves effort, honesty, maturity, responsibility, diagnosis, or character.

safety.stopRule: Stop the physical route when permission, supervision, a safe setting, or an expected material is missing, or when a new hazard appears. Continue only when the authorized adult resolves it; otherwise use the complete fictional route.
safety.physicalBoundary: The learner follows the source safety notes and never performs adult-only handling, transport, account, legal, medical, heat, sharp-tool, electrical, chemical, or machine actions.
safety.noShameRule: Describe only the observable step, condition, evidence, or revision. Never label the learner, household, body, ability, effort, maturity, responsibility, or character.

privacy.rule: Collect the smallest process record that shows the lesson steps. A learner may choose fictional details and may decline private disclosure without losing credit.
doNotCollect: names, signatures, addresses, or exact locations
account, identification, medical, product, or medicine details
photos, audio, video, passwords, or private household schedules

may: coach the guided and retry cards
mayNot: observe or claim a physical condition
tutorBoundary.physicalCompletionRule: Tutor or AI may coach. Tutor or AI may not certify that a real-world physical action occurred.
tutorBoundary.missingResourceAction: Stop and name the unresolved resource. Do not fabricate it; use another complete delivered route only when every resource for that route resolves.
